meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你把消息通道(如 Telegram、Slack)连接到代理组,管理会话隔离级别(共享会话、独立会话或独立代理),并查看或调整现有接线。
howto.when: 当你在设置中加入新通道、添加额外的群组/聊天,或想重新配置现有通道与代理组的连接时,Claude 会介入处理。

say.text: 帮我把一个新的 Telegram 群接到现有代理组上。
say.note: 会引导你完成配对和注册。

say.text: 查看当前所有通道和代理组的连接情况。
say.note: 显示已接线和未接线的通道。

say.text: 把某个通道移到另一个代理组。
say.note: 更新接线;旧会话保留在原组。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you connect messaging channels (e.g., Telegram, Slack) to agent groups, manage session isolation levels (shared session, separate conversations, or separate agent), and view or adjust existing wiring.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you add a new channel during setup, add an extra group/chat, or want to reconfigure existing channel-to-agent-group wiring.

say_en.text: Help me connect a new Telegram group to an existing agent group.
say_en.note: Walks you through pairing and registration.

say_en.text: Show me the current connections between channels and agent groups.
Move a channel from one agent group to another.
say_en.note: Updates wiring; old sessions stay with old group.
